name: 44707 · Canton, OH
findings: ZIP 44707 (Canton) has 43 nonprofit organizations. 18 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 15 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 44707 (Canton) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 44707 (Canton) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 15 organizations here; 21% of all organizations here have no identified type.
